# openwebui_files (Data Source)

Returns a filtered list of files uploaded to Open WebUI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openwebui_files" "all" {}

# The extracted text of every file arrives in data_json by default, which makes
# for a large state file when the documents are large. Set content = false to
# read the file records without it.
data "openwebui_files" "manuals" {
  filename = "manual"
  content  = false
  limit    = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `content` (Boolean) Whether Open WebUI includes each file's extracted text, which arrives inside `data_json`. Defaults to `true`. Set it to `false` to keep the text of large documents out of Terraform state.
- `filename` (String) Filename substring to filter by. Returns all files if omitted.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return.
- `skip` (Number) Number of results to skip for pagination.

### Read-Only

- `files` (Attributes List) List of files matching the filter criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the file was uploaded.
- `data_json` (String) JSON data blob associated with the file. It carries the file's extracted text while `content` is `true`.
- `filename` (String) Original filename as stored by Open WebUI.
- `hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the file content.
- `id` (String) UUID of the file.
- `meta_json` (String) JSON metadata blob associated with the file.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the file record was last updated.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the Open WebUI account that owns this object.
